bottleneck.description: Top-3 SMT placement-equipment vendor (with ASMPT and Yamaha) -- structural oligopoly in chip-mounter machines.

dependency.key_customers: Global EMS (Foxconn, Pegatron, Flex), OEMs running in-house PCB assembly, automotive electronics suppliers
dependency.key_suppliers: Linear motion components, vision systems, custom electronics

editorial.notes: SMT placement is a structural 3-player oligopoly (Fuji + ASMPT + Yamaha) with high process-engineering know-how and qualified-recipe stickiness across customer factories. Cross-vendor switching requires nozzle library, vision recipe and feeder reconfiguration that takes quarters. Not a sole-source (each competitor offers full-range substitutes), justifying MEDIUM rather than HIGH.
